title: Graceful upgrade quarantine and config shadow healing for on-prem tenants
creator: Jasmine Patel
description: Background: Over the past two months we have seen a class of customer escalations where operator-led Helm upgrades for Private/VPC tenants enter a partial state: some controllers reconcile, others fail due to webhook timeouts or image pull races. The result is config divergence (shadowed values in the operator store vs. live manifests) and repeated rollout attempts that cause tenant service disruption. This ticket proposes a low-risk quarantining mechanism for in-flight tenant upgrades and an automated 'config shadow healing' flow that performs safe three-way reconciliation and a hotfix release for the operator. Goals: 1) Prevent repeated aggressive upgrades from making tenant state worse; 2) Provide an automated repair path that merges operator-intended values, tenant runtime state, and last-known-good snapshots; 3) Ship a hotfix operator release and an onprem runbook for customer escalations.
observability_notes: Emit config_shadow_diff metric (bucketed by diff type: secret-schema, image-digest, helm-values)
comments: 2026-03-02 - Jasmine Patel: Spun up initial postmortem for 3 high-severity customer escalations. Root causes appear to be webhook timeouts during webhook rotation, OCI rate-limiting on image pulls, and non-idempotent helm hooks that create orphaned resources. Starting with a proposal for an upgrade quarantine gate + automated healing so we don't repeatedly reapply broken manifests.

2026-03-04 - Liam O'Connor: Prototype of quarantine controller completed. Behavior: when an upgrade fails more than 2 times within 10 minutes for a tenant, mark tenant as QUARANTINED, disable automatic retry, persist a snapshot of pre-upgrade manifests and KV cache to tenant namespace. Patch available in github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/4187.

2026-03-06 - SRE (Chen Wu): Load test notes: quarantine gating prevents thrashing in simulated failure modes; however leader election delays cause quarantined tenants to remain in quarantine longer than intended. Suggest a soft-lease timeout (default 30m) that can be configured per-tenant.

2026-03-07 - Security (Alma Reyes): Confirmed that snapshot persistence uses envelope encryption with KMS. Need to add audit log events for snapshot-create and quarantine-entered. Marked security_review_required = true.

2026-03-09 - Liam O'Connor: Design for config shadow healing: three-way merge between (A) last-known-good snapshot, (B) tenant live manifests and kube state, (C) operator desired helm values. Healing engine will prefer secrets and image-digests from last-known-good unless operator explicitly updated digest in release notes. Implemented dry-run path that emits a reconcile plan; linked PR contains the dry-run output and unit tests.

2026-03-11 - Customer Success (Priya Desai): Communicated temporary mitigation to affected customers: when quarantined, operator will not auto-upgrade and support can run healing plan via CLI (redwoodctl tenant heal --plan-id). Customers requested visibility into exact diffs; adding plan export as downloadable tar.gz.

2026-03-12 - QA (Marco Alvarez): End-to-end test matrix executed across three k8s versions and two CNI providers. Found an edge case where CRD conversion webhooks cause reconcile failures post-heal; added FAIL_IF_CRD_CONVERT_UNSAFE flag to prevent automatic heal in that scenario.

2026-03-14 - Liam O'Connor: Preparing hotfix release notes and deploy checklist. Hotfix will include: quarantine controller, healing dry-run CLI, telemetry, and helm-charts guard changes to make hook execution idempotent. Plan to cut operator-2026.03-hotfix.1 tomorrow. Post-deploy tasks: run canary on 5 internal tenants and monitor quarantine and heal success metrics for 48 hours. If green, roll forward to Dedicated customers under controlled window.

2026-03-14 - Jasmine Patel: Next steps: finish customer-facing KB, schedule runbook walkthrough with Support, and create follow-ups to reduce root causes (webhook robustness, OCI pull retries, and helm hook idempotency).
acceptance_criteria: Quarantine gate exists and prevents more than N automated retries (configurable) for a tenant upgrade
Snapshots of pre-upgrade state are persisted encrypted and can be retrieved for healing
Healing dry-run produces a reconcile plan that is human-reviewable and matches tests
Hotfix operator release published and canary validated in staging with no regression to normal upgrade paths
Customer KB and runbook published and shared with Support and Oncall
